name: usage-tracker
description: Track Claude 5-hour and weekly plan limits per device — plus Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and other agents ccusage supports: per-device usage, caps, model / effort breakdown, web dashboard. /usage-tracker:status shows every device.

server_url.title: Tracker server URL
server_url.description: Your Claude Usage Tracker server, e.g. https://usage.example.com. Open it in a browser and click Create account to get a token.

token.title: Account token
token.description: The cut_… token from the tracker website. Use the same token on every device so they are grouped under one account.

device_name.title: Device name
device_name.description: How this device appears on the dashboard (letters, digits, space, _ . -). Empty uses the hostname.
